title: warm wholesome filipino chicken pancit canton
description: a tangy and silky filipino noodle dish featuring wholegrain mustard, chicken, and vegetables, served in a braised sauce
instructions: heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat
add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds
add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes
remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside
add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender, about 2-3 minutes
add the snow peas and stir-fry for another minute
add the wholegrain mustard, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine
add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce
cook for another minute to allow the flavors to meld
cook the pancit canton noodles according to the package instructions and drain
add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce
season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot
